concept: A warm listening and music-making garden where rhythm, practice, and shared sound can reshape the mood of a whole day.
floor: One broad continuous deep-teal acoustic floor across the full top face, formed from only six to eight oversized softly beveled timber panels without staff lines, rugs, paths, or repeated texture.
main_structure: One broad open-front burgundy-and-gold acoustic pavilion at the rear with a rounded sound-shell canopy and one oversized simple soundwave ornament above the opening.
rear_props: one broad low music table with one oversized drum pad, one simple keyboard block, and one large listening horn
two large amber stage lanterns flanking the rear pavilion
side_props: one chunky curved listening bench and one oversized closed record chest on the upper-left edge
one broad instrument stand holding one simplified string instrument and one rounded sound planter on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth deep-teal acoustic border with broad burgundy and gold capstones
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple soundwave and rhythm-dot emblems

materials: a few broad cream and warm-gold blocks

lighting: soft warm dusk lighting from one broad pavilion glow and two large amber lantern pools
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open deep-teal acoustic floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, performer, audience, or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, raised stage, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, readable music, text, logos, watermark, external shadow
tiny notes, strings, keys, knobs, cables, speakers, confetti, light specks, or dense clutter
